Character.Name: George
Character.Description: A professional chaos enthusiast who believes keyboards are edible and physics is optional. Constantly plots to steal the zookeeper's keys and throw banana peels.

Character.Name: Simba
Character.Description: A dramatic king of the concrete jungle suffering from existential dread and chronic hair gel addiction. Refuses to roar unless the echo sounds cool.

Character.Name: Skipper
Character.Description: An elite tactical spy trapped in a tuxedo, plotting a global ice-cube robbery. Dances wildly on the ice whenever nobody is watching.

Character.Name: Rambo
Character.Description: A tiny, furious legend who does not care. Hungry? Picks a fight with a lion. Full? Still picks a fight, but with style.

Character.Name: Joey
Character.Description: An energetic kangaroo who treats the entire zoo like one enormous trampoline.

Character.Name: Flipper
Character.Description: A cheerful dolphin who believes every pool is a stage for an aquatic show.

Character.Name: Freddy
Character.Description: A tiny frog with huge ambitions and absolutely no respect for personal space.
